messages:
Zane: Quick check-in 1: were targeting tomorrow 2026-03-18 10:00 PT for the v1.12 rollout. Need console + docs to go live together. Status?
Maya: SDK docs regen is still a manual step. Netlify preview looks good but we need to push sdk version bump first. @Eli can you confirm?
Eli: On it. PR for sdk docs generation is green but waiting on package.json version bump to 1.12.0. I pushed the docs branch but will hold final push until version is confirmed. Commit: `a3f9d2b`.
Linh: Changelog on `release/v1.12` updated. Added console telemetry + routing policy notes. Still need annotated tag and release notes file.
Jordan (SQA): I can run smoke 45m before the window. Checklist: login + token auth, chat generation, embeddings sample, basic perf p95. Post results here.
Maya: Netlify preview: https://docs.redwood.example/preview/1789build-45 1. Prod deploy is manual — I wont hit it until tag is pushed.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: I can run prod deploy when authorized. Please post `@deploy-bot authorize` in this thread.
docs-bot: docs-bot: Latest main build 1789build-45 705. Preview link above.
Eli: Regen steps for whoever runs it:
```
./scripts/gen-sdk-docs.sh && yarn workspace @redwood/sdk docs:build && git add docs/sdk && git commit -m \"regen sdk docs\" && git push origin release/v1.12
```
Note: ensure `packages/sdk/package.json` version is `1.12.0` first.
Maya: Also remember the SDK changelog entry for breaking-compat note (small wording tweak).
Linh: Tag sequence Ill run once docs+sdk are green:
```
git checkout release/v1.12
git pull origin release/v1.12
git tag -a v1.12.0 -m \"v1.12.0: console telemetry + routing\"
git push origin v1.12.0
```
Zane: Freeze cutoff at 08:30 PT. No merges after that unless emergency. Tag cut ~09:50 PT so Jordan has time.
Maya: Anyone planning last-minute merges after 08:30 PT? Call them out now.
Linh: No merges from me. No hotfixes unless critical.
Eli: SDK docs pushed to release branch at `a3f9d2b`, but version still needs bump.
Jordan (SQA): Ill be on at 09:15 PT for pre-deploy smoke. Will post pass/fail and short logs.
Zane: @deploy-bot please standby. I will authorize when tag is up.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: awaiting explicit authorizer to run queued actions.
Zane: @deploy-bot authorize
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Authorisation received from Zane. Ready to execute on request.
Maya: Ill hold prod docs button until tag confirmation and will capture a rollback snapshot before deploy.
Linh: Tag pushed and release notes published. GH release page updated.
Zane: Start console rollout at 10:00 PT. @deploy-bot kick off canary then ramp.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Console rollout started. Canary 5% -> 50% -> 100% if healthy. Reporting here.
Maya: Waiting 2m after canary healthy to hit docs prod.
docs-bot: docs-bot: Prod deploy started: build prod-1789-01. Live preview: https://deploys.redwood.example/prod-1789-01
Eli: Heads-up: please disable `fast-kv-cache` feature flag for the canary, we saw noise in canary perf previously.
Jordan (SQA): Canary pass: chat flows + auth OK. Running embedding samples and some p95 checks now.
Jordan (SQA): Embedding checks passed. No auth errors. No console exceptions in logs for canary window.
Maya: Docs prod is live for v1.12.0: https://docs.redwood.example 1. Spot-checked release notes and SDK pages.
Zane: Great. If anything looks off, post rollback request here and well revert. Ill follow up with metrics tomorrow.
Maya: Nice job team! :party:
